summary: This Form 8-K filed by Mercedes-Benz Auto Receivables Trust 2026-1 (issuing entity) and Mercedes-Benz Retail Receivables LLC (depositor) reports the closing of a $997.87 million asset-backed securitization of auto receivables. The filing attaches legal and tax opinions from Sidley Austin LLP regarding the notes offered under a prospectus dated May 12, 2026. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or corporate-control change is described. The filing is a routine ABS issuance current report mandated by Regulation AB, not a special situation.
